lore.common: Keeps everyone waiting at the gate, then leaves ten minutes early when they're in the café.
lore.uncommon: Draws long white lines across the blue sky, and never finishes the picture.
lore.rare: Sent everybody's suitcase to a different country, and kept the socks.
lore.epic: Took off so loudly that every car alarm in the airport car park joined in.
lore.legendary: Flew round the whole world in a single day, then landed and asked why everyone looked so tired.

names.legendary: Old Kitty Kestrel, Ace of the Fair

lore.common: Coughs and splutters on every take-off, so the farmer's cows lie down in protest.
lore.uncommon: Has two sets of wings, in case it loses one, it says.
lore.rare: Looped the loop so close to the haystack that it blew the scarecrow's hat off.
lore.epic: Flew upside down over the county show and every spectator's ice cream fell on their shoes.
lore.legendary: Flew under every bridge on the river in one afternoon, and still landed in time for tea.

lore.common: Hangs around on the airfield all morning waiting for someone else to pull it into the air.
lore.uncommon: Has no engine at all, so it floats so quietly that birds fly alongside to check it's real.
lore.rare: Circled up a warm air bubble so high that it ended up above the clouds.
lore.epic: Soared across three counties without a single sound, and the cows didn't even look up.
lore.legendary: Stayed in the air for a whole day riding warm wind, and the eagles asked how it did it.

names.legendary: Major Whoosh, Ace of the Bedroom

lore.common: Is flown round the living room with loud whooshing noises until it crashes into the dog.
lore.uncommon: Has a little plastic pilot who hasn't blinked in ten years.
lore.rare: Fired its spring-loaded missile across the room and knocked the biscuit off the plate.
lore.epic: Fought a dogfight with every toy plane in the house, and the curtains were badly injured.
lore.legendary: Was flown in a thousand imaginary missions, crashed in nine hundred, and still has both wings.

lore.common: Lands on the lake right where the ducks were having their meeting.
lore.uncommon: Has floats for feet, so it wobbles about on the water like a duck on stilts.
lore.rare: Hopped from lake to lake all day, delivering post to cabins with no roads.
lore.epic: Landed in the bay so splashily that every sailing boat got a free wash.
lore.legendary: Delivered a birthday cake to an island with no airport, landed in the waves, and the icing wasn't even smudged.

names.legendary: Commander Starlite of the Bunk Bed

lore.common: Counts down from ten every time you pick it up, then refuses to launch.
lore.uncommon: Has wobbly plastic fins that never stand up straight on the shelf.
lore.rare: Launched off the bunk bed and landed in the laundry basket, mission complete.
lore.epic: Blasted off with a pump of air and went over the garden fence into next door's pond.
lore.legendary: Has been to the moon a thousand times, according to its owner, and always back before bedtime.

lore.common: Wails its siren just as you're about to fall asleep, then turns round the next corner.
lore.uncommon: Writes its name backwards on the front so other drivers can read it in their mirror.
lore.rare: Parted a traffic jam just by flashing its blue lights, like a magic trick.
lore.epic: Raced through the whole city in rush hour, and every car pulled over at once like a wave.
lore.legendary: Got across the busiest city in the world in ten minutes, and the patient had only a splinter.

names.legendary: Grand Montgolfiera, Queen of the Breeze

lore.common: Roars its burner right above your head at six in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Floats wherever the wind takes it, so it never knows where it will land.
lore.rare: Landed in a field of sheep, and the sheep followed it for a mile.
lore.epic: Floated over the city with a hundred other balloons, and everyone went to work late.
lore.legendary: Drifted across a whole mountain range with nothing but hot air and good luck.

lore.common: Leaves a hot black road behind it that smells like a burnt pancake.
lore.uncommon: Moves so slowly that the workers walk beside it chatting the whole time.
lore.rare: Laid a brand new road down the street in one day, and everyone's car was stuck at home.
lore.epic: Paved every pothole in town in one night, and the cyclists cried with happiness.
lore.legendary: Laid a road so smooth from coast to coast that drivers could hear their own tyres purring.

lore.common: Pushes the same pile of dirt back and forth all day as if it lost something.
lore.uncommon: Lowers its big blade like a grumpy face whenever someone walks past.
lore.rare: Pushed a hill out of the way to make a car park, and the hill went somewhere else.
lore.epic: Cleared a whole building site in one morning, and the workers had to find something else to do.
lore.legendary: Moved a mountain one push at a time, and the mountain now lives two miles further down the valley.

lore.common: Smooths out the gravel road, then leaves a little ridge right in the middle for you to bump over.
lore.uncommon: Has its blade in the middle of its body, like a giant with a belt buckle.
lore.rare: Dug a ditch along the whole lane so neatly that the rainwater ran away with a grin.
lore.epic: Smoothed out every dirt road in the county so well that the farmers' eggs stopped breaking.
lore.legendary: Graded a road so flat across the desert that you can roll a marble from one end to the other.

lore.common: Rolls over the same bit of road a hundred times as if it hasn't noticed.
lore.uncommon: Moves so slowly that pigeons walk beside it to keep it company.
lore.rare: Flattened the fresh tarmac so smooth that skateboarders queued to try it.
lore.epic: Rolled every new road in the town flat in a single week, and the town looked freshly ironed.
lore.legendary: Rolled out a playground so flat that every marble in it has stayed exactly where it was dropped.

lore.common: Spins on the spot like it's dancing, then scoops up the wrong pile.
lore.uncommon: Turns round in its own space by skidding its wheels, and leaves rubber circles everywhere.
lore.rare: Fit through a garden gate that every other digger was too big for.
lore.epic: Moved a whole hill of sand in one afternoon, and the beach volleyball club moved in.
lore.legendary: Did the work of ten bigger diggers in one week, then fitted back into its tiny garage.

lore.common: Puffs clouds of steam over the hedge and makes the washing on the line smell smoky.
lore.uncommon: Has a huge iron roller at the front that clanks like an old kettle.
lore.rare: Whistled so loudly at the village green that the cricketers dropped the ball.
lore.epic: Rolled up and down the village street for a whole day, and every bump disappeared.
lore.legendary: Has been rolling roads since great-grandad was a boy, and still gets polished every Sunday.

names.legendary: Big Shovelina, Queen of the Quarry

lore.common: Scoops up a huge bucket of gravel and drops half of it on the way to the lorry.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its bucket high like it's showing off a trophy.
lore.rare: Filled a lorry with one scoop, and the lorry sagged on its springs.
lore.epic: Moved every pile of gravel in the quarry in one day, and the quarry looked like a different place.
lore.legendary: Built a gravel mountain so tall that the quarry workers put a flag on top.

lore.common: Pulls away from the stop just as you reach it, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Hisses and kneels down at every stop like it's bowing to the passengers.
lore.rare: Fit forty schoolchildren, two dogs and a tuba on board, and still had room for a pram.
lore.epic: Carried the whole town to the seaside on the hottest day, and the beach ran out of sand space.
lore.legendary: Ran its route for fifty years without being late once, and the clock tower sets its time by it.

lore.common: Beeps its horn in the car park just to say hello to other cars.
lore.uncommon: Can never find a parking space near the shop, and always parks crooked.
lore.rare: Packed a whole family, a tent and a dog into its boot for a camping trip.
lore.epic: Got stuck in the biggest traffic jam ever and played the radio so loud that everyone sang along.
lore.legendary: Drove a million miles in one lifetime and still has the same fluffy dice hanging from its mirror.

lore.common: Rolls through the only puddle in the car park and splashes your clean trousers.
lore.uncommon: Has a shiny hubcap that it keeps losing in the hedge.
lore.rare: Rolled off the car on a hill and overtook the car on the way down.
lore.epic: Rolled through the whole town after coming loose, and every dog chased it.
lore.legendary: Rolled all the way to the sea from the mountain garage, and was found floating on its own.

names.legendary: Calipra, Who Stopped the Runaway Bus

lore.common: Squeals loudly every time the car stops at the lights, so everyone turns to look.
lore.uncommon: Gets so hot after driving down a hill that you could warm your hands on it.
lore.rare: Stopped a speeding car so quickly that the shopping slid onto the front seat.
lore.epic: Squealed so loudly down the mountain road that every goat on the hill jumped.
lore.legendary: Stopped a runaway bus on the steepest hill in town, and the passengers clapped.

lore.common: Drips a little petrol on your shoe after every fill-up.
lore.uncommon: Ticks up the price so fast that it looks like it's racing.
lore.rare: Clicked off at exactly the wrong moment and left everyone in the queue grumbling.
lore.epic: Filled every car on the motorway before the holiday weekend, and still had fuel to spare.
lore.legendary: Fuelled ten thousand cars on the same corner for forty years, and still says thank you on its little screen.

names.legendary: Sir Gleamsworth, Grin of the Highway

lore.common: Catches every bug on the motorway and keeps them as souvenirs.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a grinning face on the front of the car, especially when the headlights are on.
lore.rare: Glinted so brightly in the sun that the car behind had to put on sunglasses.
lore.epic: Grinned at the traffic jam with its chrome teeth until every other car looked grumpy.
lore.legendary: Has been polished every Sunday for forty years and is now the shiniest grille in the country.

lore.common: Clip-clops down the lane at its own pace, and the cars behind have to wait.
lore.uncommon: Carries a load of hay so high that the driver can't see over it.
lore.rare: Bounced over the cobbles so hard that all the apples fell out at once.
lore.epic: Brought the whole harvest to market in one trip, and the town ate pie for a week.
lore.legendary: Has carried every bride in the village to the church for a hundred years, and the horse still knows the way.

names.legendary: Grandad Tin, the First on the Road

lore.common: Needs a crank turned at the front to start, and kicks back at anyone who does it wrong.
lore.uncommon: Only comes in black, and is quite proud of it.
lore.rare: Putt-putted through the town so loudly that the horses all looked up from their hay.
lore.epic: Drove the dusty road from one town to the next, and the dust cloud reached the next county.
lore.legendary: Is over a hundred years old and still wins the vintage car parade by starting first time.

names.legendary: Grand Ox Wagon of the Valley

lore.common: Creaks so loudly on every turn of its wheel that the birds fly off.
lore.uncommon: Goes at the speed of a walking ox, which is the slowest speed there is.
lore.rare: Got stuck in the mud and pulled itself out with one heave from the ox.
lore.epic: Carried the whole village's harvest in one trip, and nobody's barn had any room left.
lore.legendary: Has been pulled along the same valley road for two hundred years, and its wheels are as round as ever.

lore.common: Locks tight every time you lean forward to reach the radio.
lore.uncommon: Twists itself into a knot every time you put it on.
lore.rare: Clicked shut so firmly that the dog couldn't escape, even for a sausage.
lore.epic: Locked every passenger into the coach at once, and the driver finally had peace.
lore.legendary: Has kept millions of people safe without ever once being thanked by name.

lore.common: Keeps its drum spinning even when it's parked, like it's afraid to stop.
lore.uncommon: Pours wet concrete everywhere except where it's supposed to go.
lore.rare: Mixed a load so thick that a builder's wellie is still stuck in the new path.
lore.epic: Poured the foundations for a whole street in one day, and the street's footprints are now permanent.
lore.legendary: Poured the concrete for the biggest bridge in the country, and still had enough left to make a paddling pool.

lore.common: Lifts the worker up to the street light, then gets stuck halfway down.
lore.uncommon: Can reach the top of a three-storey house without leaving the pavement.
lore.rare: Rescued a kitten from the top of a tree, and the kitten wanted to go up again.
lore.epic: Changed every light bulb on the high street in one night, and the town shone like Christmas.
lore.legendary: Reached the top of the clock tower and fixed the clock just before New Year.
